changelog.name: 域见 ScopeView 0.0.17
changelog.body:
# 域见 ScopeView 0.0.17 一眼看清哪些 LSPosed 模块作用于某个应用，不用再逐个点开查找。 See at a glance which LSPosed modules target an app, without opening them one by one. 集中查看模块更新，支持单个更新和批量更新。 Check module updates in one place and update them individually or in a batch. 按应用查看 LSPosed 模块作用域，只读展示，不修改作用域配置。 View LSPosed module scopes by app without changing the scope configuration. 支持从模块详情跳转到 LSPosed 管理器中的对应模块。 Open the corresponding module in LSPosed Manager from its details. 自行联网刷新官方目录，跟随 LSPosed 管理器的更新通道，联网失败时显示缓存结果，并识别仅名称变化的版本更新。 Refresh the official catalog directly, follow LSPosed Manager's selected channel, show cached results if the network fails, and recognize version-name-only updates. 有更新的模块始终优先显示，组内保留你选择的排序规则。 Modules with available updates always appear first, with your selected sort order preserved within each group. 支持单个更新、多选后的“更新所选”和顺序执行的“更新全部”；Beta、Nightly 和多 APK 项目由你逐项选择或跳过，没有 APK 的更新需你确认跳过。 Update one module, use Update selected for a chosen subset or run the sequential Update all queue; choose or skip each Beta, Nightly, or multi-APK item, and explicitly skip updates with no APK. 取消剩余更新时，会等待当前项完成，再停止后续项目。 Cancelling remaining updates lets the current item finish before stopping the rest. 安装前核验 APK 包名和版本，Root 安装失败时可使用系统安装器。 Verify the APK package name and version before installation, with the system installer available if Root installation fails. 支持按名称或包名搜索，并分别保存应用、模块和作用域详情的排序规则。 Search by name or package name and save separate sort preferences for apps, modules and scope details. 界面默认跟随系统语言，也可手动选择简体中文或英文。 The interface follows the system language by default, with manual Simplified Chinese and English options. ## 本次更新 / What's new in 0.0.17 - 修复取消勾选某个应用作用域后，关联模块从详情中消失的问题：保留曾成功读取的关联，显示“对此应用已停用”，并独立显示模块总开关；不修改 LSPosed 配置。
Fix modules disappearing from app details after scope deselection: retain previously read associations, show them as disabled for that app and display the module switch separately, without modifying LSPosed configuration. - 导出日志新增逐模块的关联和状态快照，包含 Android 用户、作用域勾选、模块开关、更新通道、版本及下载/安装/批量状态，并标明读取时间与数据是否可用。
Add per-module associations and state snapshots to exported logs, including Android users, scope selections, module switches, update channels, versions and download/install/batch states, with read times and data availability. - 慢操作日志补充具体模块、应用、界面和执行阶段，保留阶段峰值的上下文，方便追查卡顿；正常路径累计有界计数，慢事件限频，格式化、写盘和完整快照生成在后台执行。
Add module, app, screen and execution-stage context to slow-operation logs and retain peak-stage context for diagnosing delays. Normal paths use bounded counters, slow records are rate-limited, and formatting, disk writes and full snapshot generation run in the background. - 导出时补充本应用最近的系统退出原因；系统仍保留且允许读取时，附带有长度上限的 ANR 轨迹，缺失或读取失败会明确标记。
Include recent system exit reasons for ScopeView during export. Add a size-limited ANR trace when the system retains and permits it, explicitly marking missing or unreadable data. - 扳手设置新增“安装包清理”，异步显示可清理和保留的大小，手动清理已安装同版、旧版本安装包及中断下载，并报告实际释放量。
Add APK cleanup to Settings, showing removable and retained sizes asynchronously. Manually clear installed or older APKs and interrupted downloads, with the actual released space reported. - 清理仅处理域见私有安装缓存，保留待安装、正在使用、较新版本及自身更新核对文件；无法确认归属的文件保留，下载或安装占用时提示稍后清理。
Cleanup only handles ScopeView's private installation cache, retaining pending or in-use installers, newer versions, self-update verification files and files with uncertain ownership. Active downloads or installations prompt you to try later. 未曾读取且已从管理器删除的作用域关联无法恢复；需要先重新勾选并让域见成功读取一次，之后取消才可保留显示。
Deleted scope associations never read by ScopeView cannot be recovered. Select them again and let ScopeView read them successfully before deselecting to retain their display. 你的 Star ⭐ 是我持续更新的最大动力。
Your Star ⭐ is my biggest motivation to keep updating ScopeView.

Add module selection, Update selected and Select current results, retaining hidden search selections and the existing Update all, per-APK choice/skip and self-last rules. - 新增默认开启、可独立关闭的后台更新提醒，每四小时检查官方仓库并沿用最近一次管理器通道；仅通知，不自动下载或安装。省电限制可能延迟，强行停止后重新打开恢复。
Add separately configurable, default-on background reminders that check the official repository every four hours using the last Manager channel. Checks only notify and never download or install. Power limits may delay checks; reopen after force stop. - 界面升级为 Material 3 Expressive，统一浅色/深色主题、按钮、开关、进度和对话框。
Upgrade to Material 3 Expressive with consistent light/dark themes, buttons, switches, progress indicators and dialogs. - 回到前台的自动刷新加入十分钟冷却，从上一轮读取完成后计时；手动刷新即时执行，安装返回只核对目标模块。
Add a ten-minute cooldown after the previous read finishes for automatic foreground refreshes. Manual refreshes remain immediate, and returning from installation checks only the target module. - 优化大量模块的列表刷新：保留卡片与图标，分帧绑定变化，折叠日志延后解析；修复界面重建后的滚动位置恢复，主动滚动优先。
Improve large module lists by retaining cards and icons, binding changes across frames and delaying collapsed changelog parsing. Restore scroll position after recreation while prioritizing manual scrolling. - 扩展性能日志，记录点击、主线程阻塞、帧及后台排队/执行耗时；异步批量写入、有界队列和慢记录限频，导出含队列与阶段汇总。
Extend diagnostics across clicks, main-thread stalls, frames and background queue/execution time, with asynchronous batched writes, bounded queues, rate-limited slow records and exported summaries. - 修复部分 Beta/Nightly 版本实际有 APK 却被判为无附件的问题，兼容通道指针引用通用发布列表；保留包名、版本和安装校验。
Fix missing APK detection when Beta/Nightly pointers reference the shared release list, retaining package, version and installation validation. - 补充 LSPosed、Irena、Vector 的已知管理器启动入口兼容，保留独立、寄生和秘密代码备用入口。
Extend known Manager launch compatibility for LSPosed, Irena and Vector while retaining standalone, parasitic and secret-code fallbacks. - 调整常驻通知为低干扰的标准状态模板，减少 ColorOS 17 的显示误识别；该 ROM 的最终显示仍待用户确认。
Use a low-interruption standard status template for the persistent shortcut to reduce ColorOS 17 misclassification; final rendering on that ROM still needs user confirmation. 你的 Star ⭐ 是我持续更新的最大动力。

Check official details for installed, listed modules during refresh to reduce missed updates from an outdated full catalog; no need to open the LSP repository first, with Stable, Beta and Nightly channels retained and failed checks keeping their existing results with a notice. - 常驻通知支持 Root 系统入口：授权 Root 和通知权限后，划掉后台或停止域见仍保留快捷入口，点击即可重新打开；默认开启并尊重已有关闭选择，扳手设置可关闭并移除。
Add a Root system shortcut for the persistent notification: after granting Root and notification permission, it remains when ScopeView is removed from Recents or stopped and opens the app when tapped; it is enabled by default, respects an existing off choice and can be removed from Settings. - Root 通知发布完成后进程退出，不增加持续保活进程或后台更新/安装任务；未授权 Root 时保留普通通知入口。

Fix the unusual shadow on the LSPosed connection expand/collapse button in light mode, retaining manual expansion, collapse and automatic collapse after a successful read. 官方详情服务仍可能存在短时缓存，本版本不保证发布后秒级发现更新。
Official details may still be cached briefly; this release does not guarantee detection seconds after publication. 你的 Star ⭐ 是我持续更新的最大动力。

# 域见 ScopeView 0.0.5 一眼看清哪些 LSPosed 模块作用于某个应用，不用再逐个点开查找。 See at a glance which LSPosed modules target an app, without opening them one by one. 集中查看模块更新，支持单个更新和批量更新。 Check module updates in one place and update them individually or in a batch. 按应用查看 LSPosed 模块作用域，只读展示，不修改作用域配置。 View LSPosed module scopes by app without changing the scope configuration. 支持从模块详情跳转到 LSPosed 管理器中的对应模块。 Open the corresponding module in LSPosed Manager from its details. 读取 LSPosed 管理器的仓库缓存，跟随其更新通道，显示缓存时间并识别仅名称变化的版本更新。 Read the LSPosed Manager's repository cache, follow its selected channel, show the cache timestamp and recognize updates that only change the version name. 有更新的模块始终优先显示，组内保留你选择的排序规则。 Modules with available updates always appear first, with your selected sort order preserved within each group. 支持单个更新和顺序执行的“更新全部”；Beta、Nightly 和多 APK 项目由你逐项选择或跳过，没有 APK 的更新需你确认跳过。 Update one module or use the sequential Update all queue; choose or skip each Beta, Nightly, or multi-APK item, and explicitly skip updates with no APK. 取消剩余更新时，会等待当前项完成，再停止后续项目。 Cancelling remaining updates lets the current item finish before stopping the rest. 安装前核验 APK 包名和版本，Root 安装失败时可使用系统安装器。 Verify the APK package name and version before installation, with the system installer available if Root installation fails. 支持按名称或包名搜索，并分别保存应用、模块和作用域详情的排序规则。 Search by name or package name and save separate sort preferences for apps, modules and scope details. 界面默认跟随系统语言，也可手动选择简体中文或英文。 The interface follows the system language by default, with manual Simplified Chinese and English options. ## 本次更新 / What's new in 0.0.5 - 直接隐藏当前用户未安装或未识别的模块配置，以及仅关联这些记录的应用；数量和排序只统计已安装模块，不修改 LSPosed 原配置。
Hide configuration records for modules not installed or recognized for the current user, and apps linked only to those records; counts and sorting use installed modules without changing LSPosed configuration. - 优化域见自身更新：批量任务最后处理域见，安装前保存目标版本和此前结果，重新打开后核对实际版本并恢复结果，避免进程替换丢失记录。
Improve ScopeView self-updates: process ScopeView last in a batch, save the target version and earlier results before installation, and verify the installed version and restore results when reopened. - 自身更新取消、失败或尚未确认时不误报成功，保留有效安装包供手动重试；Root 和系统安装入口继续可用，不自动重复旧任务。
Do not report cancelled, failed or unconfirmed self-updates as successful; retain valid APKs for manual retry, keep Root and system-installer routes, and avoid automatically repeating old tasks. 你的 Star ⭐ 是我持续更新的最大动力。
Your Star ⭐ is my biggest motivation to keep updating ScopeView.

域见 ScopeView

每次更新 LSP 模块都要一个个点进去下载，根本不清楚有多少模块同时作用于某个应用？我来帮你。
Updating LSP modules means opening each one to download, with no clear view of how many modules target the same app? I'm here to help.
一眼看清哪些 LSPosed 模块作用于某个应用，不用再逐个点开查找。
See at a glance which LSPosed modules target an app, without opening them one by one.
集中查看模块更新，支持单个更新和批量更新。
Check module updates in one place and update them individually or in a batch.
域见是独立的 Root 配套工具，无需激活 LSPosed 模块也可使用原有功能。
ScopeView is a standalone Root companion utility; its existing features work without activating the LSPosed module.

你的 Star ⭐ 是我持续更新的最大动力。
Your Star ⭐ is my biggest motivation to keep updating ScopeView.

公开下载 / Downloads · 官方索引 / Official index

## 主要功能 / Features - **按应用查看模块**：查看一个应用被哪些模块选入作用域，显示应用名称、包名、图标及 Android 用户信息。
**Modules by app:** See which modules include an app in their scopes, with app names, package names, icons and Android user information. - **查看模块更新**：直接检查已安装模块的官方详情，并核对管理器缓存；沿用更新通道，失败时保留已有结果，识别仅名称变化的更新。
**Check module updates:** Check official details for installed modules and reconcile the Manager cache; follow the selected channel, retain existing results on failure and recognize version-name-only updates. - **通知快捷入口**：默认开启，点击通知打开域见；授权 Root 和通知权限后，划掉后台仍保留入口，设置中可关闭并保存选择。
**Notification shortcut:** Enabled by default; tap to open ScopeView. With Root and notification permission granted, it remains after removing the app from Recents; turn it off in Settings with your choice saved. - **优先显示更新**：有更新的模块始终排在前面，各组内保留你选择的排序规则。
**Updates first:** Modules with available updates always appear first, with your chosen sort order preserved within each group. - **单个、多选或全部更新**：支持更新单个模块、勾选后“更新所选”或“更新全部”；Beta、Nightly 和多 APK 项目由你逐项选择或跳过，没有 APK 的更新需你确认跳过。
**Individual, selected or all updates:** Update one module, select several with Update selected or use Update all; choose or skip each Beta, Nightly, or multi-APK item, and explicitly skip updates with no APK. - **取消剩余任务**：等待当前更新完成，再停止后续更新。
**Cancel remaining updates:** Let the current update finish, then stop the remaining items. - **搜索与排序**：按名称或包名搜索，为应用、模块和作用域详情分别保存排序规则。
**Search and sort:** Search by name or package name and save separate sort preferences for apps, modules and scope details. - **中英界面**：默认跟随系统语言，也可手动选择简体中文或英文。
**Chinese and English:** Follow the system language by default or choose Simplified Chinese or English manually. - **跳转管理器**：从模块详情打开 LSPosed 管理器中的对应模块。
**Open in Manager:** Open the corresponding module in LSPosed Manager from its details. - **模块日志与诊断**：展开或收起模块发布说明，支持 Markdown；导出日志包含各模块的关联和状态快照，慢操作标明界面、模块与阶段。
**Module notes and diagnostics:** Expand or collapse Markdown release notes. Export logs with per-module associations and state snapshots, plus screen, module and stage context for slow operations. - **安装包清理**：在扳手设置查看并清理已安装或旧版本的缓存包与中断下载；保留待安装、较新版本和自身更新核对所需的文件。
**APK cleanup:** Inspect and clear installed or older cached APKs and interrupted downloads in Settings, while retaining pending installers, newer versions and files needed to verify ScopeView's own update. - **后台更新提醒**：默认每四小时联网检查，有更新时通知；设置中可独立关闭，沿用最近一次读取的管理器通道，不自动下载或安装。系统省电限制可能延后检查，强行停止后需重新打开域见。
**Background reminders:** Check online every four hours by default and notify about updates. Disable this separately in Settings. Checks follow the last Manager channel without automatic downloads or installation. Power restrictions may delay checks; reopen ScopeView after force stop. - **Material 3 Expressive**：提供浅色和深色界面，保留固定标题栏与自然滚动；大列表分帧更新，重建界面后恢复滚动位置。
**Material 3 Expressive:** Light and dark interfaces retain the fixed toolbar and natural scrolling. Large lists update across frames and restore their scroll position after recreation. ## 使用要求 / Requirements - Android 13 或更高版本。
Android 13 or later. - 使用 LSPosed，并允许域见读取已安装应用列表。
Use LSPosed and allow ScopeView to access the installed app list. - 读取作用域、读取 LSPosed 本机仓库缓存及直接安装更新需要 Root 授权；更新目录也会从官方公开源刷新。
Root authorization is required to read scopes and LSPosed's local repository cache and to install updates directly; the catalog also refreshes from the public official source. ## 作用域 / Scope 作用域仅声明域见自身（`io.github.zhongjitianqianguai.scopeview`），无需勾选其他应用。
The scope declaration only lists ScopeView itself (`io.github.zhongjitianqianguai.scopeview`); no other apps need to be selected. Xposed 入口仅在域见主进程加载时写一条框架日志，不拦截应用行为；读取配置和更新模块仍通过 Root 完成，无需激活该模块。
The Xposed entry only writes a framework log when ScopeView's main process loads and does not intercept app behavior; configuration reads and module updates still use Root and do not require module activation. ## 开始使用 / Getting started 1. 打开域见，点击“读取作用域”，按授权指引允许 Root。
Open ScopeView, tap Read scopes and follow the guide to grant Root access. 2. 在应用列表中搜索目标应用，查看关联模块。
Search for an app in the app list to see its associated modules. 3. 首次成功读取后，回到前台的自动刷新设有十分钟冷却；冷却从上一轮读取结束时开始，手动刷新不受影响。
After the first successful read, automatic foreground refreshes have a ten-minute cooldown starting when the previous read finishes; manual refreshes remain immediate. 4. 切换到模块更新列表，选择单个更新、勾选后“更新所选”或“更新全部”。
Switch to the module update list to update one module, use Update selected or Update all. 5. 点击“刷新更新”获取官方目录；应用会沿用 LSPosed 管理器的通道，并在联网失败时显示可用缓存。
Tap Refresh updates to fetch the official catalog; ScopeView follows LSPosed Manager's channel and shows usable cached results if the request fails. ## 使用说明 / Usage notes 域见只读显示作用域，不修改 LSPosed 配置。
ScopeView displays scopes without modifying the LSPosed configuration. 已读取的关联会保存在域见本地；在管理器中取消勾选后，仍显示为“对此应用已停用”，并与模块总开关状态分开。未曾读取且已删除的关联无法还原，未安装或未识别模块仍隐藏。
Associations already read are saved locally in ScopeView. After deselection in the Manager, they remain visible as disabled for that app, separately from the module switch. Deleted associations never read cannot be recovered; uninstalled or unrecognized modules remain hidden. 后台检查只发出提醒，下载和安装必须由你主动发起；Beta、Nightly 和多 APK 版本需要你选择，稳定版单 APK 可加入更新队列。
Background checks only send reminders; downloads and installation require your explicit action; choose Beta, Nightly and multi-APK releases, while a stable release with one APK can enter the update queue automatically. 安装前会核验包名与版本，并保留 Android 的签名和兼容性检查。
Package names and versions are verified before installation, while Android retains its signature and compatibility checks. Root 安装失败时，可将已验证的 APK 交给系统安装器。
If Root installation fails, the verified APK can be handed to the system installer. 作用域记录保留 Android 用户 ID，应用名称和已安装状态按当前用户显示。
Scope records retain Android user IDs, while app names and installation status are resolved for the current user. Android 的同包 APK 由多个用户共享，因此更新模块也会更新其他已安装该模块的用户所使用的程序代码。
Android shares package code across users, so updating a module also updates the code used by other users who have that package installed. ## 测试版迁移 / Migrating from test builds 正式版使用专用签名，无法直接覆盖此前本地安装的调试版。
The release uses a dedicated signing key and cannot directly replace a locally installed debug build. 卸载调试版会删除其应用数据，迁移前请保留需要的本地设置。
Uninstalling the debug build removes its app data; preserve any local settings you need before migrating.

**Modules by app:** See which modules include an app in their scopes, with app names, package names, icons and Android user information. - **查看模块更新**：直接检查已安装模块的官方详情，并核对管理器缓存；沿用更新通道，失败时保留已有结果，识别仅名称变化的更新。
**Check module updates:** Check official details for installed modules and reconcile the Manager cache; follow the selected channel, retain existing results on failure and recognize version-name-only updates. - **通知快捷入口**：默认开启，点击通知打开域见；授权 Root 和通知权限后，划掉后台仍保留入口，设置中可关闭并保存选择。
**Notification shortcut:** Enabled by default; tap to open ScopeView. With Root and notification permission granted, it remains after removing the app from Recents; turn it off in Settings with your choice saved. - **优先显示更新**：有更新的模块始终排在前面，各组内保留你选择的排序规则。
**Updates first:** Modules with available updates always appear first, with your chosen sort order preserved within each group. - **单个、多选或全部更新**：支持更新单个模块、勾选后“更新所选”或“更新全部”；Beta、Nightly 和多 APK 项目由你逐项选择或跳过，没有 APK 的更新需你确认跳过。
**Individual, selected or all updates:** Update one module, select several with Update selected or use Update all; choose or skip each Beta, Nightly, or multi-APK item, and explicitly skip updates with no APK. - **取消剩余任务**：等待当前更新完成，再停止后续更新。
**Cancel remaining updates:** Let the current update finish, then stop the remaining items. - **搜索与排序**：按名称或包名搜索，为应用、模块和作用域详情分别保存排序规则。
**Search and sort:** Search by name or package name and save separate sort preferences for apps, modules and scope details. - **中英界面**：默认跟随系统语言，也可手动选择简体中文或英文。
**Chinese and English:** Follow the system language by default or choose Simplified Chinese or English manually. - **跳转管理器**：从模块详情打开 LSPosed 管理器中的对应模块。
**Open in Manager:** Open the corresponding module in LSPosed Manager from its details. - **模块日志与诊断**：展开或收起模块发布说明，支持 Markdown；导出日志包含各模块的关联和状态快照，慢操作标明界面、模块与阶段。
**Module notes and diagnostics:** Expand or collapse Markdown release notes. Export logs with per-module associations and state snapshots, plus screen, module and stage context for slow operations. - **安装包清理**：在扳手设置查看并清理已安装或旧版本的缓存包与中断下载；保留待安装、较新版本和自身更新核对所需的文件。
**APK cleanup:** Inspect and clear installed or older cached APKs and interrupted downloads in Settings, while retaining pending installers, newer versions and files needed to verify ScopeView's own update. - **后台更新提醒**：默认每四小时联网检查，有更新时通知；设置中可独立关闭，沿用最近一次读取的管理器通道，不自动下载或安装。系统省电限制可能延后检查，强行停止后需重新打开域见。
**Background reminders:** Check online every four hours by default and notify about updates. Disable this separately in Settings. Checks follow the last Manager channel without automatic downloads or installation. Power restrictions may delay checks; reopen ScopeView after force stop. - **Material 3 Expressive**：提供浅色和深色界面，保留固定标题栏与自然滚动；大列表分帧更新，重建界面后恢复滚动位置。
**Material 3 Expressive:** Light and dark interfaces retain the fixed toolbar and natural scrolling. Large lists update across frames and restore their scroll position after recreation. ## 使用要求 / Requirements - Android 13 或更高版本。
Android 13 or later. - 使用 LSPosed，并允许域见读取已安装应用列表。
Use LSPosed and allow ScopeView to access the installed app list. - 读取作用域、读取 LSPosed 本机仓库缓存及直接安装更新需要 Root 授权；更新目录也会从官方公开源刷新。
Root authorization is required to read scopes and LSPosed's local repository cache and to install updates directly; the catalog also refreshes from the public official source. ## 作用域 / Scope 作用域仅声明域见自身（`io.github.zhongjitianqianguai.scopeview`），无需勾选其他应用。
The scope declaration only lists ScopeView itself (`io.github.zhongjitianqianguai.scopeview`); no other apps need to be selected. Xposed 入口仅在域见主进程加载时写一条框架日志，不拦截应用行为；读取配置和更新模块仍通过 Root 完成，无需激活该模块。
The Xposed entry only writes a framework log when ScopeView's main process loads and does not intercept app behavior; configuration reads and module updates still use Root and do not require module activation. ## 开始使用 / Getting started 1. 打开域见，点击“读取作用域”，按授权指引允许 Root。
Open ScopeView, tap Read scopes and follow the guide to grant Root access. 2. 在应用列表中搜索目标应用，查看关联模块。
Search for an app in the app list to see its associated modules. 3. 首次成功读取后，回到前台的自动刷新设有十分钟冷却；冷却从上一轮读取结束时开始，手动刷新不受影响。
After the first successful read, automatic foreground refreshes have a ten-minute cooldown starting when the previous read finishes; manual refreshes remain immediate. 4. 切换到模块更新列表，选择单个更新、勾选后“更新所选”或“更新全部”。
Switch to the module update list to update one module, use Update selected or Update all. 5. 点击“刷新更新”获取官方目录；应用会沿用 LSPosed 管理器的通道，并在联网失败时显示可用缓存。
Tap Refresh updates to fetch the official catalog; ScopeView follows LSPosed Manager's channel and shows usable cached results if the request fails. ## 使用说明 / Usage notes 域见只读显示作用域，不修改 LSPosed 配置。
ScopeView displays scopes without modifying the LSPosed configuration. 已读取的关联会保存在域见本地；在管理器中取消勾选后，仍显示为“对此应用已停用”，并与模块总开关状态分开。未曾读取且已删除的关联无法还原，未安装或未识别模块仍隐藏。
Associations already read are saved locally in ScopeView. After deselection in the Manager, they remain visible as disabled for that app, separately from the module switch. Deleted associations never read cannot be recovered; uninstalled or unrecognized modules remain hidden. 后台检查只发出提醒，下载和安装必须由你主动发起；Beta、Nightly 和多 APK 版本需要你选择，稳定版单 APK 可加入更新队列。
Background checks only send reminders; downloads and installation require your explicit action; choose Beta, Nightly and multi-APK releases, while a stable release with one APK can enter the update queue automatically. 安装前会核验包名与版本，并保留 Android 的签名和兼容性检查。
Package names and versions are verified before installation, while Android retains its signature and compatibility checks. Root 安装失败时，可将已验证的 APK 交给系统安装器。
If Root installation fails, the verified APK can be handed to the system installer. 作用域记录保留 Android 用户 ID，应用名称和已安装状态按当前用户显示。
Scope records retain Android user IDs, while app names and installation status are resolved for the current user. Android 的同包 APK 由多个用户共享，因此更新模块也会更新其他已安装该模块的用户所使用的程序代码。
Android shares package code across users, so updating a module also updates the code used by other users who have that package installed. ## 测试版迁移 / Migrating from test builds 正式版使用专用签名，无法直接覆盖此前本地安装的调试版。
The release uses a dedicated signing key and cannot directly replace a locally installed debug build. 卸载调试版会删除其应用数据，迁移前请保留需要的本地设置。
Uninstalling the debug build removes its app data; preserve any local settings you need before migrating.
